import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
import cli, pyref

binary = cli.build()
rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 9)
N = 8192
d = {}
clusters = [((rng.getrandbits(64) >> 16) << 16, rng.getrandbits(64)) for _ in range(600)]
while len(d) < N:
    hi, lo = rng.getrandbits(64), rng.getrandbits(64)
    l = rng.randint(0, 128)
    if rng.random() < 0.7:
        ch, cl = rng.choice(clusters)
        keep = rng.randint(0, 64)
        hi = (ch >> keep) << keep
        lo = (cl >> keep) << keep if keep else cl
    hi, lo = pyref.norm(hi, lo, l)
    d[(hi, lo, l)] = rng.randint(0, 4194302)
    # keep front-key bounds
    f16 = set(k[0] >> 48 for k in d if 17 <= k[2] <= 64)
    f64 = set(k[0] for k in d if k[2] >= 65)
    if len(f16) > 4096 or len(f64) > 4096:
        del d[(hi, lo, l)]
puts = list(d.items())
ops = []
for i in range(131072):
    (h, l, ln), hop = puts[rng.randrange(len(puts))]
    ops.append(["put", "%016x%016x" % (h, l), ln, hop])
addrs = ["%016x%016x" % (rng.getrandbits(64), rng.getrandbits(64)) for _ in range(65536)]
addrs2 = ["%016x%016x" % (k[0], k[1]) for k in puts[:65536 % len(puts)]]
ops.append(["query", addrs])
ops.append(["save"])
ops.append(["load_saved", 0])
ops.append(["image_query", addrs + addrs2])
ops.append(["query", addrs2])
req = {"cases": [{"ops": ops}]}
raw = json.dumps(req)
print('request bytes', len(raw), 'ops', len(ops))
t = time.time()
res = cli.results(req, binary)
print('elapsed %.2fs' % (time.time() - t))
r = res[0]
print('answers', len(r['answers']), 'snapshots', len(r['snapshots']), 'loads', r['loads'])
snap = r['snapshots'][0]
print('cells', snap['cells'], 'rows', sum(len(b) for b in snap['banks']), 'bitmaps', len(snap['bitmaps']), 'ni', len(snap['nexthops']))
print('response bytes', len(json.dumps(res)))
t = time.time()
got = pyref.validate(snap)
print('pyref validate %.2fs' % (time.time() - t), 'prefixes', len(got))
# answers check
m = pyref.Fib()
for k, v in d.items(): m.put(k[0], k[1], k[2], v)
exp = []
for a in addrs + addrs2:
    hi = int(a[:16], 16); lo = int(a[16:], 16)
    exp.append(m.lookup_upto(hi, lo))
exp2 = [exp[i] for i in range(len(addrs2))]
ans = r['answers']
print('live check', ans[:len(addrs)] == [m.lookup_upto(int(a[:16],16), int(a[16:])) for a in addrs])
print('image check', ans[len(addrs):len(addrs)+len(addrs)+len(addrs2)] == exp)
print('live2 check', ans[len(addrs)+len(addrs)+len(addrs2):] == exp2)
